statement: Let n = len(distance). Let total = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} distance[i]. Let d = (destination - start) mod n, taken in [0,n). Let cw = sum_{k=0}^{d-1} distance[(start + k) mod n], with cw = 0 when d = 0. The function returns a result r and r = min(cw, total - cw).
preconditions: Let n = len(distance). Assume 1 <= n <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= distance[i] <= 10000; and 0 <= start < n and 0 <= destination < n. (distance is a slice of 64-bit integers; start and destination are 64-bit integer indices.)
